sources.entry: ProfileCreator - macOS Application to create standard or customized configuration profiles.

summary.one_liner: ProfileCreator is a macOS application for building standard or customized configuration profiles.
summary.what_it_does: ProfileCreator is a macOS application for creating configuration profiles, which can be standard or customized. The README describes it only briefly and does not list specific features. Payloads (the individual settings within a profile) are contributed through a separate ProfileManifests repository, which the README links to along with a getting-started guide for writing manifests. The project is built with Xcode and includes git submodules that must be initialized before compiling. The README also names two bundled open-source components: WFColorCode and Highlightr. Questions are directed to the project wiki and the #profilecreator channel in the MacAdmins Slack.
use_cases: build custom payloads for a managed Mac fleet
how_to_run: Download the latest release from the Releases page
notable: Payload definitions live in a separate ProfileManifests repository, so new settings can be added as manifests
Builds with standard Xcode tooling via xcodebuild
Community support through the MacAdmins Slack #profilecreator channel and project wiki
caveats: Requires macOS 11 or newer to run
Building from source requires Xcode 14 or higher and macOS 12.0 or higher
README gives little detail on specific features or usage
